plugins.name: backend-architecture
plugins.description: Core architecture, patterns and code conventions for the NestJS + TypeScript + MongoDB backend stack, packaged as auto-invoking skills, with a read-only convention reviewer and a skill that adopts the reference template. Covers universal code conventions, project bootstrap and module wiring, the domain/application/persistence/presentation layers, API documentation, money, transactions and consistency, event-driven side effects, pagination, error handling, observability, deployment, authentication and authorization, security hardening, configuration, i18n, audit logging, background jobs, external integrations, testing, git workflow and decision records. Depends on nothing.
